_what: Every word the progress lines, the share card and the public share page say (src/progress-trends.mjs, src/share-pages.mjs). Destinations are where a share can go: each a label, the web address its logo is read from (domain) or a named icon and the address it opens, with {url} and {text} filled in (encoded). Adding a place to share is one row here.
trends_body: Each point is one of your decisions, oldest on the left.

trend_deciding.label: Time to decide
trend_deciding.better: Down from {before} in your earlier decisions
trend_deciding.worse: Up from {before} in your earlier decisions

trend_goals.label: Goals hit
trend_goals.detail: {met} of {known} decisions with a result reached their goal
trend_goals.none: No results yet. Say how a decision went and it shows here.

share_body: The card shows your numbers only, never what your decisions were about.
share_text: {headline}. I make my decisions with Trillion.

page.title: {headline} · Trillion
page.description: Numbers from one person's own decisions with Trillion. Only the numbers are shared, never what the decisions were about.
page.body: These are one person's own numbers, measured by Trillion as they decided and as they said how each decision went. What the decisions were about stays private.
page.cta_heading: Make your next decision with Trillion
page.cta_body: Trillion works inside the AI you already use. Each choice is weighed against what you are working toward, and every result makes the next decision better.
page.gone_body: The person who shared it removed it.

actions.failed: Your card could not be made in this browser. Copy the link instead, or try again.
